summary: Iteration-13 review: 16 backend assertions across version/admin-password-rotation/admin-session-expiry/mobile-gating/multi-tier-referral-payout/admin-search-by-mobile + mobile-first frontend smoke. Backend 15/16 PASS, 1 real bug (withdraw doesn't enforce mobile_number). Frontend was BROKEN at boot (UpdateGate import paths were ../src/lib/theme and ../assets/images/icon.png — both wrong). Fixed both import paths; app now boots, force-update gate, profile long-press admin, refer screen, and withdraw mobile inputs all render correctly.

critical.issue: Mobile-number gating NOT implemented. Spec says: when user.mobile_number is empty, return 400 with detail mentioning 'mobile number'. Current handler (server.py L1029-1061) skips this check entirely → returns 200 and creates the withdraw. Frontend UI shows the mobile inputs but the server doesn't enforce, so mismatched/missing-mobile clients can still withdraw.

ui_bugs.issue: Two broken imports caused a Metro red-screen on every route, blocking the entire app: (1) `import { theme } from '../src/lib/theme'` should be `'../lib/theme'`. (2) `require('../assets/images/icon.png')` should be `'../../assets/images/icon.png'` (file lives in src/components/, asset in /assets). Both fixed by tester.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend correctly hides wd-mobile1/wd-mobile2 once user.mobile_number is set and shows them otherwise, but submitting bypasses the backend validation because /api/withdraw does not 400 when mobile_number is absent. Frontend currently calls POST /api/profile/mobile first, but if a client skips that the withdraw still succeeds.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing 'shadow*'/'textShadow*'/'pointerEvents' deprecation warnings only — not blocking.

action_items: Fix POST /api/withdraw (server.py ~L1029) to add: `if not user.get('mobile_number'): raise HTTPException(400, 'Please add your mobile number before withdrawing')` before the points/method validations.
Optional: collapse UpdateGate import-path style (use `@/lib/theme` alias if configured) to prevent future relative-path mistakes.

Consider an integration test of the public /refer screen showing actual referee rows (this run had zero referrals, so refhist-<user_id> rendering was not visually exercised — backend shape is verified though).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/withdraw bypasses the brand-new mobile_number gate that the rest of the iteration was built around — the entire iteration's mobile-gate requirement is broken on the backend.

UpdateGate import paths suggest the file was authored without running Metro — the bundler would have failed on first save. Recommend a pre-commit `expo export` smoke for new top-level component additions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after import fix (boot blocked before fix)

seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral device users + admin promotions + a temporary referral_settings tier override + a temporary version doc, all cleaned up per test class. No persistent test data.

rca_of_issue: Withdraw mobile-gating bug RCA: server.py L1029 submit_withdraw validates points/method/UPI/Bank but never reads user['mobile_number']. The companion endpoint POST /api/profile/mobile sets the field, but withdraw is independent and runs even if it's null. Reproduce: device-login → ensure user.mobile_number=null in DB → POST /api/withdraw {method:'upi', points:100, upi_id:'x@upi'} → expect 400 'add your mobile number'; got 200 + withdraw row. Mitigation: 1-line guard at top of submit_withdraw.
